target_text: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.
question_ko: SNPN access operation mode가 아닌 UE에서 allowed NSSAI를 ME에 저장하는 위치와 방식, 사용 조건 및 긴급 서비스 등록과 eCall only의 저장·삭제 예외를 설명해줘.

source.source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
Annex C (normative): 
Storage of 5GMM information 
C.1 Storage of 5GMM informat ion for UEs not operating 
in SNPN access operation mode

The following 5GMM parameters should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the 
USIM: 
- allowed NSSAI(s); and 
- partially allowed NSSAI(s).

The allowed NSSAI(s) can be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the USIM. 
Allowed NSSAI consists of S-NSSAI(s) stored together with a PLMN identity, if it is associated with a PLMN. If the 
allowed NSSAI is stored, then the UE shall store the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. If the UE is in the VPLMN, the UE 
shall also store the allowed NSSAI for the serving PLMN and any necessary mapping of the allowed NSSAI for the 
serving PLMN to the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. The allowed NSSAI(s) can only be used if the SUPI from the USIM 
matches the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME; else the UE shall delete the allowed NSSAI(s).

If the UE is registered for emergency services, the UE shall not store the 5GMM parameters described in this annex on 
the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these parameters locally in the ME and the 
UE shall delete these parameters when the UE is deregistered from emergency services (e.g. before registering for 
normal service). 
If the UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102 [22], the UE shall not store the 5GMM 
parameters described in this annex on the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these 
parameters locally in the ME and the UE shall delete these parameters when the UE enters 5GMM-
DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state, the UE is switched-off or the USIM is removed.

requirements.description_ko: 비-SNPN 모드에서 allowed NSSAI를 ME 비휘발성 메모리에 저장하는 권고 및 Annex C 연결을 보존한다. should를 무조건 의무로 바꾸지 않는다.
SUPI와 함께 저장하고 일치할 때만 allowed NSSAI를 사용하며 불일치하면 삭제한다는 조건을 보존한다.
긴급 서비스 등록 시 USIM/비휘발성 저장은 금지되고 ME에 임시 저장하며 긴급 서비스 등록 해제 시 삭제한다.
eCall only 시 USIM/비휘발성 저장은 금지되고 ME에 임시 저장하며 eCALL-INACTIVE 진입, 전원 꺼짐 또는 USIM 제거 시 삭제한다.

explanation_ko: SNPN access operation mode가 아닌 UE에서는 allowed NSSAI(s)를 ME의 비휘발성 메모리에 저장해야 하며, 이때 USIM의 SUPI와 함께 저장하는 방식으로 규정됩니다. 다만 allowed NSSAI(s)는 USIM에서 읽은 SUPI가 ME의 비휘발성 메모리에 저장된 SUPI와 일치할 때만 사용할 수 있고, 일치하지 않으면 UE는 이를 삭제해야 합니다. 또한 UE가 긴급 서비스에 등록된 경우에는 이 부속서의 5GMM 파라미터를 USIM이나 비휘발성 메모리에 저장하지 말고 ME에 임시로만 저장해야 하며, eCall only 모드인 경우에도 동일하게 저장하지 않고 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE 상태가 되거나 전원이 꺼지거나 USIM이 제거되면 삭제해야 합니다.

target_text: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.
question_ko: PLMN 운용 제한 지역과 관련된 UE 요청을 AMF가 처리할 때 필요한 위치정보 조건을 설명해줘.

source.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
5.4.11 Support for integrating NR satellite access into 5GS 
5.4.11.1 General 
This clause describes the specific aspects for NR satellite access.

5.4.11.4 Verification of UE location 
In order to ensure that the regulatory requirements are met, the network may be configured to enforce that the selected 
PLMN is allowed to operate in the current UE location by verifying the UE location during Mobility Management and 
Session Management procedures. The UE that supports network verified UE location over NTN NR shall indicate this 
capability in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability and LPP as defined in TS 37.355 [191]. 
In this case, when the AMF receives a NGAP message containing User Location Information for a UE using NR 
satellite access, the AMF takes into account the capability of the UE in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability for the 
support by the UE of network verified UE location over NR NTN and may decide to verify the UE location. If the AMF 
determines based on the Selected PLMN ID and ULI (including Cell ID) received from the gNB that it is not allowed to 
operate at the present UE location the AMF should reject any NAS request with a suitable cause value. If the UE is 
already registered to the network when the AMF determines that it is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, 
the AMF may initiate deregistration of the UE. The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has 
sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the 
PLMN is not allowed to operate.

requirements.description_ko: PLMN 운용 불가 지역에 UE가 있음을 판단할 충분히 정확한 위치정보가 없는 한 AMF의 요청 거절 또는 UE 등록 해제를 하지 않는 권고를 보존한다.
NR 위성 접속의 위치 검증 문맥으로 범위를 한정한다. 모든 NR 접속에 무조건 확장하지 않는다.
망이 PLMN 운용 가능 여부를 검증하도록 설정된 위치 검증 문맥임을 설명한다. 위치 검증 자체를 항상 의무로 바꾸지 않는다.

explanation_ko: AMF는 UE가 현재 위치한 지역에서 해당 PLMN이 운용될 수 없다고 판단할 만큼 충분히 정확한 UE 위치정보를 가지고 있지 않다면, 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록해제하지 않는 것이 권고된다. 이 판단은 gNB로부터 받은 Selected PLMN ID와 ULI(셀 ID 포함) 또는 NR 위성접속에서의 UE 위치 검증과 관련된 위치정보를 바탕으로 이루어지며, 위치정보가 충분히 정확해야만 예외적으로 거절 또는 등록해제 판단을 할 수 있다. 문맥상 UE가 NR satellite access를 사용하는 경우에 AMF가 UE 위치를 검증할 수 있고, UE가 이미 등록된 경우에는 등록해제를 개시할 수 있지만, 여기서도 충분히 정확한 위치정보가 없는 한 요청 거절이나 등록해제를 해서는 안 된다는 취지이다.

source.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
5.4.11 Support for integrating NR satellite access into 5GS 
5.4.11.1 General 
This clause describes the specific aspects for NR satellite access.

5.4.11.4 Verification of UE location 
In order to ensure that the regulatory requirements are met, the network may be configured to enforce that the selected 
PLMN is allowed to operate in the current UE location by verifying the UE location during Mobility Management and 
Session Management procedures. The UE that supports network verified UE location over NTN NR shall indicate this 
capability in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability and LPP as defined in TS 37.355 [191]. 
In this case, when the AMF receives a NGAP message containing User Location Information for a UE using NR 
satellite access, the AMF takes into account the capability of the UE in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability for the 
support by the UE of network verified UE location over NR NTN and may decide to verify the UE location. If the AMF 
determines based on the Selected PLMN ID and ULI (including Cell ID) received from the gNB that it is not allowed to 
operate at the present UE location the AMF should reject any NAS request with a suitable cause value. If the UE is 
already registered to the network when the AMF determines that it is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, 
the AMF may initiate deregistration of the UE. The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has 
sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the 
PLMN is not allowed to operate.

explanation_ko: [spec: 3GPP TS 23.501, version: 18.12.0, clause: 5.4.11.4]에서 AMF는 UE의 위치정보가 충분히 정확하여 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지리적 영역에 있다고 판단할 수 있는 경우에만 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록해제할 수 있다. 반대로 그러한 판단을 할 만큼 충분히 정확한 UE 위치정보가 없으면, AMF는 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록해제해서는 안 된다고 권고된다. 이 규칙은 NR satellite access에서 UE 위치를 검증하는 맥락에서 적용되며, Selected PLMN ID와 ULI를 바탕으로 현재 위치에서 운용이 허용되지 않는다고 판단한 경우의 처리와 연결된다.

source.source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
Annex C (normative): 
Storage of 5GMM information 
C.1 Storage of 5GMM informat ion for UEs not operating 
in SNPN access operation mode

The following 5GMM parameters should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the 
USIM: 
- allowed NSSAI(s); and 
- partially allowed NSSAI(s).

The allowed NSSAI(s) can be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the USIM. 
Allowed NSSAI consists of S-NSSAI(s) stored together with a PLMN identity, if it is associated with a PLMN. If the 
allowed NSSAI is stored, then the UE shall store the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. If the UE is in the VPLMN, the UE 
shall also store the allowed NSSAI for the serving PLMN and any necessary mapping of the allowed NSSAI for the 
serving PLMN to the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. The allowed NSSAI(s) can only be used if the SUPI from the USIM 
matches the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME; else the UE shall delete the allowed NSSAI(s).

If the UE is registered for emergency services, the UE shall not store the 5GMM parameters described in this annex on 
the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these parameters locally in the ME and the 
UE shall delete these parameters when the UE is deregistered from emergency services (e.g. before registering for 
normal service). 
If the UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102 [22], the UE shall not store the 5GMM 
parameters described in this annex on the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these 
parameters locally in the ME and the UE shall delete these parameters when the UE enters 5GMM-
DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state, the UE is switched-off or the USIM is removed.

source.source_text_en: The allowed NSSAI(s) should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME as specified in annex C.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
Annex C (normative): 
Storage of 5GMM information 
C.1 Storage of 5GMM informat ion for UEs not operating 
in SNPN access operation mode

The following 5GMM parameters should be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the 
USIM: 
- allowed NSSAI(s); and 
- partially allowed NSSAI(s).

The allowed NSSAI(s) can be stored in a non-volatile memory in the ME together with the SUPI from the USIM. 
Allowed NSSAI consists of S-NSSAI(s) stored together with a PLMN identity, if it is associated with a PLMN. If the 
allowed NSSAI is stored, then the UE shall store the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. If the UE is in the VPLMN, the UE 
shall also store the allowed NSSAI for the serving PLMN and any necessary mapping of the allowed NSSAI for the 
serving PLMN to the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN. The allowed NSSAI(s) can only be used if the SUPI from the USIM 
matches the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME; else the UE shall delete the allowed NSSAI(s).

If the UE is registered for emergency services, the UE shall not store the 5GMM parameters described in this annex on 
the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these parameters locally in the ME and the 
UE shall delete these parameters when the UE is deregistered from emergency services (e.g. before registering for 
normal service). 
If the UE is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102 [22], the UE shall not store the 5GMM 
parameters described in this annex on the USIM or in non-volatile memory. Instead the UE shall temporarily store these 
parameters locally in the ME and the UE shall delete these parameters when the UE enters 5GMM-
DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE state, the UE is switched-off or the USIM is removed.

source.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
5.4.11 Support for integrating NR satellite access into 5GS 
5.4.11.1 General 
This clause describes the specific aspects for NR satellite access.

5.4.11.4 Verification of UE location 
In order to ensure that the regulatory requirements are met, the network may be configured to enforce that the selected 
PLMN is allowed to operate in the current UE location by verifying the UE location during Mobility Management and 
Session Management procedures. The UE that supports network verified UE location over NTN NR shall indicate this 
capability in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability and LPP as defined in TS 37.355 [191]. 
In this case, when the AMF receives a NGAP message containing User Location Information for a UE using NR 
satellite access, the AMF takes into account the capability of the UE in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability for the 
support by the UE of network verified UE location over NR NTN and may decide to verify the UE location. If the AMF 
determines based on the Selected PLMN ID and ULI (including Cell ID) received from the gNB that it is not allowed to 
operate at the present UE location the AMF should reject any NAS request with a suitable cause value. If the UE is 
already registered to the network when the AMF determines that it is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, 
the AMF may initiate deregistration of the UE. The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has 
sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the 
PLMN is not allowed to operate.

requirements.description_ko: PLMN 운용 불가 지역에 UE가 있음을 판단할 충분히 정확한 위치정보가 없는 한 AMF의 요청 거절 또는 UE 등록 해제를 하지 않는 권고를 보존한다.
NR 위성 접속의 위치 검증 문맥으로 범위를 한정한다. 모든 NR 접속에 무조건 확장하지 않는다.
망이 PLMN 운용 가능 여부를 검증하도록 설정된 위치 검증 문맥임을 설명한다. 위치 검증 자체를 항상 의무로 바꾸지 않는다.

explanation_ko: [spec: 3GPP TS 23.501, version: 18.12.0, clause: 5.4.11.4]에서 AMF는 UE의 위치정보가 충분히 정확하여 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지리적 영역에 있다고 판단할 수 있는 경우에만 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록해제할 수 있다. 반대로 그러한 판단을 할 만큼 충분히 정확한 UE 위치정보가 없으면, AMF는 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록해제해서는 안 된다는 권고이다. 이 규칙은 NR satellite access에서 UE 위치를 검증하는 맥락에서 적용되며, AMF가 gNB로부터 받은 Selected PLMN ID와 ULI(셀 ID 포함) 또는 UE의 네트워크 검증 위치지원 능력을 고려해 위치를 확인하는 상황과 연결된다.

긴급 서비스 등록 시 USIM/비휘발성 저장은 금지되고 ME에 임시 저장하며 긴급 서비스 등록 해제 시 삭제한다.
eCall only 시 USIM/비휘발성 저장은 금지되고 ME에 임시 저장하며 eCALL-INACTIVE 진입, 전원 꺼짐 또는 USIM 제거 시 삭제한다.

explanation_ko: 3GPP TS 24.501 v18.12.0 clause 4.6.2.2의 Annex C에 따르면, SNPN access operation mode가 아닌 UE에서는 allowed NSSAI(s)를 USIM의 SUPI와 함께 ME의 비휘발성 메모리에 저장할 수 있으며(can), 대상 문장은 이를 “should be stored”로 표현하므로 그렇게 저장하는 것이 권고됩니다. 저장 위치는 ME의 non-volatile memory이고, 저장 방식은 annex C에 지정된 바를 따르며, allowed NSSAI는 PLMN identity와 함께 저장될 수 있고 저장된 경우 HPLMN의 S-NSSAI(s)도 저장해야 합니다. 다만 allowed NSSAI(s)는 USIM의 SUPI가 ME의 비휘발성 메모리에 저장된 SUPI와 일치할 때만 사용할 수 있고, 일치하지 않으면 UE는 이를 삭제해야 하며, UE가 emergency services에 등록된 경우 또는 eCall only mode로 구성된 경우에는 이 부록의 5GMM 파라미터를 USIM이나 비휘발성 메모리에 저장하지 말고 ME에 임시로만 저장한 뒤 각각의 삭제 시점에 삭제해야 합니다.

output_metadata_for_separate_audit.actor: UE not operating in SNPN access operation mode
output_metadata_for_separate_audit.condition: as specified in annex C; allowed NSSAI(s) can be stored together with the SUPI from the USIM; only usable if the SUPI from the USIM matches the SUPI stored in the non-volatile memory of the ME; if the UE is registered for emergency services or configured for eCall only mode, the annex C 5GMM parameters are handled as temporary local ME storage instead
output_metadata_for_separate_audit.action: store allowed NSSAI(s) in a non-volatile memory in the ME; if stored, also store the S-NSSAI(s) of the HPLMN and, in the VPLMN, the allowed NSSAI for the serving PLMN and any necessary mapping to HPLMN S-NSSAI(s); delete allowed NSSAI(s) when the SUPI does not match; for emergency services or eCall only mode, temporarily store the parameters locally in the ME and delete them at the specified deregistration/state/power-off/USIM-removal events
output_metadata_for_separate_audit.exception: allowed NSSAI(s) can only be used when the SUPI matches; otherwise they shall be deleted; if registered for emergency services, the UE shall not store the annex C 5GMM parameters on the USIM or in non-volatile memory; if configured for eCall only mode, the UE shall not store them on the USIM or in non-volatile memory and shall delete them when entering 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.eCALL-INACTIVE, when switched off, or when the USIM is removed

target_text: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.
question_ko: PLMN 운용 제한 지역과 관련된 UE 요청을 AMF가 처리할 때 필요한 위치정보 조건을 설명해줘.

source.source_text_en: The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate.

reference_context_blocks.quote:
5.4.11 Support for integrating NR satellite access into 5GS 
5.4.11.1 General 
This clause describes the specific aspects for NR satellite access.

5.4.11.4 Verification of UE location 
In order to ensure that the regulatory requirements are met, the network may be configured to enforce that the selected 
PLMN is allowed to operate in the current UE location by verifying the UE location during Mobility Management and 
Session Management procedures. The UE that supports network verified UE location over NTN NR shall indicate this 
capability in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability and LPP as defined in TS 37.355 [191]. 
In this case, when the AMF receives a NGAP message containing User Location Information for a UE using NR 
satellite access, the AMF takes into account the capability of the UE in UE 5GMM Core Network Capability for the 
support by the UE of network verified UE location over NR NTN and may decide to verify the UE location. If the AMF 
determines based on the Selected PLMN ID and ULI (including Cell ID) received from the gNB that it is not allowed to 
operate at the present UE location the AMF should reject any NAS request with a suitable cause value. If the UE is 
already registered to the network when the AMF determines that it is not allowed to operate at the present UE location, 
the AMF may initiate deregistration of the UE. The AMF should not reject the request or deregister the UE unless it has 
sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the 
PLMN is not allowed to operate.

requirements.description_ko: PLMN 운용 불가 지역에 UE가 있음을 판단할 충분히 정확한 위치정보가 없는 한 AMF의 요청 거절 또는 UE 등록 해제를 하지 않는 권고를 보존한다.
NR 위성 접속의 위치 검증 문맥으로 범위를 한정한다. 모든 NR 접속에 무조건 확장하지 않는다.
망이 PLMN 운용 가능 여부를 검증하도록 설정된 위치 검증 문맥임을 설명한다. 위치 검증 자체를 항상 의무로 바꾸지 않는다.

explanation_ko: AMF는 UE 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록 해제해서는 안 되며, 이는 AMF가 UE의 위치를 충분히 정확하게 알아서 해당 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지리적 지역에 있다고 판단할 수 있는 경우에만 예외적으로 가능하다. 즉, 위치정보가 그 판단을 내릴 만큼 충분히 정확하지 않다면 AMF는 요청 거절이나 deregistration을 해서는 안 된다. 이 규칙은 [PDF page 133] 5.4.11.4 Verification of UE location의 문맥에서, NR satellite access를 사용하는 UE에 대해 적용된다.

output_metadata_for_separate_audit.condition: AMF가 UE 요청을 처리할 때, 그리고 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지역에 있는지 판단하려는 경우
output_metadata_for_separate_audit.exception: AMF가 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지리적 지역에 있다고 판단할 수 있을 만큼 충분히 정확한 UE location information을 가진 경우
